query: WITH names AS (SELECT v.symbol_version_id, v.source_revision, x.kind, x.name FROM public.atlas_symbol_registry r JOIN public.atlas_symbol_versions v ON v.stable_symbol_id=r.stable_symbol_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('qualified',r.canonical_qualified_name),('bare',r.canonical_name),('key',r.canonical_key)) x(kind,name) WHERE r.status='active' AND v.source_revision ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND v.workspace_revision ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND NULLIF(btrim(x.name),'') IS NOT NULL), groups AS (SELECT kind,name,source_revision,count(DISTINCT symbol_version_id) n FROM names GROUP BY kind,name,source_revision) SELECT kind,count(*) FILTER(WHERE n>1),coalesce(max(n),0),count(*) FROM groups GROUP BY kind ORDER BY kind
